title: CraftRealms
description: Established in 2011, CraftRealms is a classic Minecraft network featuring a vibrant, community-driven Survival SMP alongside custom, competitive minigames.
body:
# 🏰 Welcome to CraftRealms 

**IP & Website:** `CraftRealms.com` | **Supported Versions:** `1.8.9 - 26.1.2`

**Recommended Versions:** `1.21.4+` for SMP | `1.8.9` for PvP & Minigames

*A legacy reborn.* Originally founded in 2011 with a bustling community of Towny and custom minigame players, **CraftRealms** is officially back! We are rebuilding our network from the ground up, starting with a heavily feature-packed Survival experience, with massive network expansions already in the works.

---

## 🌲 Currently Live: The Economy SMP
Jump into our expansive Survival Multiplayer world! We've designed this server to offer a balanced, community-driven economy and a stress-free building environment. 

* **Heavy Economy Focus:** Build your wealth and trade with others using our community Auction House and instant-sell shop. 
* **Land Protection:** Claim your territory and build in peace. Your hard work and items are completely safe from griefing.
* **Endless Exploration:** Utilize `/rtp` (Random Teleport) to instantly find the perfect starting biome within our massive world border.

## ⚖️ 100% Non-Pay-To-Win (Fair Play)
We strongly believe Minecraft is about playing, not paying. CraftRealms is proudly **100% Non-P2W**. We currently only offer two premium ranks, and both are strictly focused on cosmetics and minor quality-of-life conveniences. You can reach the top of the server economy and dominate completely free of charge.

---

## 🚀 Coming Soon To The Network: The Minigames
The SMP is just the beginning. We are actively expanding the network to bring back our classic minigame roots, including:

* **Custom Skywars:** Our unique, fast-paced take on the classic sky-high battle.
* **Proprietary PvPWars:** A completely custom-coded plugin and map ecosystem exclusive to CraftRealms. Join teams and wage war in massive battles featuring Free-For-All (FFA), Capture The Banner, and much more!

---
**Join the rebirth of a 2011 classic today.** 

🔗 **Connect now:** `CraftRealms.com`
